offers._source: more.co.za/offers (StayMORE, CelebrateMORE, Friends of MORE, DiscoverMORE, Best of Both Worlds), read 1 Nov 2026. Terms pages say valid 4 Feb 2026 to 31 May 2028; MORE's banners say 30 Apr 2027 for three of them (follow-up with MORE).

freeNight.name: StayMORE
freeNight.terms: One complimentary night when you book four consecutive nights. Not valid at Marataba Villa. Does not combine with CelebrateMORE; can be combined with Friends of MORE. Up to 5 rooms or 10 guests. Subject to availability.

celebrate.name: CelebrateMORE
celebrate.terms: 25% off accommodation for the guest celebrating a honeymoon, babymoon, milestone anniversary or birthday and their room-sharing partner. Three consecutive nights minimum. Does not combine with StayMORE; can be combined with Friends of MORE. Up to 5 rooms or 10 guests. Subject to availability.

returning.name: Friends of MORE
returning.terms: 10% off accommodation for guests who have stayed with MORE Collection before and the friends and family travelling with them. Combines with StayMORE and CelebrateMORE. Up to 5 rooms or 10 guests. Subject to availability.

notes: DiscoverMORE: 10% off at each lodge when you book two MORE properties (instead of the offers above)

lion-sands: Best of Both Worlds: free connecting flights with 3 nights here and 3 at Marataba
marataba: Best of Both Worlds: free connecting flights with 3 nights here and 3 at Lion Sands
